name: RaGo Lens
tagline: Remove a photo's background offline and export a transparent PNG.
summary: An offline Android app that removes a photo's background and exports a transparent PNG, with a full editor.
problem: Cutting an object out of a photo usually means uploading it to a website. RaGo Lens does it on the phone, offline, and gives you the tools to fix the edges yourself.

features.title: Background removal
features.text: Removes the background and exports a transparent PNG, offline.

features.title: Full editor
features.text: Tap to select regions, lasso and brush tools, deep zoom, and rotate, flip and scale.

features.title: Shadows
features.text: Add a shadow to the cut-out.

howItWorks.text: A background-removal model runs on the phone through ONNX Runtime, so the photo never leaves the device. The editor lets you correct the result before exporting a transparent PNG.

stack.name: ONNX Runtime
stack.role: runs the model on the phone

roadmap.text: Turn a photo of a notebook page into formatted text (OCR). This is planned and not built yet.

notice: RaGo Lens is still in development and has no public release yet.

credits.name: Background-removal model (name to confirm)
credits.provides: The segmentation model that cuts out the subject

thanks.text: A friend suggested the idea and helped choose the name. "Rago" is the Nepali word for a male buffalo, which is also the logo.
Claude and Claude Code helped plan and write the app; I test and decide what ships.
